_comment: Mutation score: the fraction of deliberately injected faults the suite kills. Line coverage says code ran; this says it was checked. Scoped to Omni-ERD's lib because that is where the real logic lives (SELECT generation, join graph, key roles) and where a silent wrong answer is expensive - a diagram that draws a join nobody can run. Whole-repo mutation is too slow to be useful; this is the subset worth the minutes.
_thresholds_comment: break is the measured score at adoption (83.39, floored). Raise it when the score rises; never lower it to make a run pass.
